headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump. And, Paramount settles in massive merger lawsuit
context: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have sued Trump after the networks were suspended from the White House. And, Paramount makes concessions to resolve a lawsuit over its massive Warner Bros. Discovery merger.
